components.name: Primary Coral Button
components.description: The dominant tactile action used to enter, upload, or confirm a companion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:58px; padding:0 22px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; border:2px solid #17324d; border-radius:14px; color:#fff; background:#e84133; box-shadow:0 6px 0 #b92720; font:900 .9rem ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#d93328; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd34f; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Quick Action Magnet

components.css: .ds-btn-quick { min-height:52px; padding:0 16px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; border:2px solid #c3d5dc; border-radius:14px; color:#17324d; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 5px 0 #dce8ea; font:900 .9rem ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-quick svg { width:24px; height:24px; fill:none; stroke:#17324d; stroke-width:1.9; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-btn-quick:hover { border-color:#17324d; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-quick:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd34f; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-quick:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Command Composer
components.description: The stage-attached offline command field with a compact coral send action.
components.html: ● 离线也能听懂常用指令
components.css: .ds-command { width:min(660px,100%); padding:16px 18px 12px; border:2px solid #17324d; border-radius:16px; color:#17324d; background:rgba(255,255,255,.96); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(23,50,77,.18); font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-command label { display:block; margin-bottom:9px; font-size:.92rem; font-weight:900; } .ds-command>div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:9px; } .ds-command input { min-width:0; height:50px; padding:0 15px; border:2px solid #abc1cb; border-radius:11px; color:#17324d; background:#fffdf8; font:750 1rem inherit; } .ds-command button { min-width:96px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:11px; border:2px solid #17324d; border-radius:11px; color:#fff; background:#e84133; font-weight:900; cursor:pointer; } .ds-command button b { width:24px; height:24px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; color:#e84133; background:#fff; } .ds-command p { margin:9px 0 0; color:#416b53; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-command input:focus-visible,.ds-command button:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd34f; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-command button:hover { background:#d93328; }

components.name: Creator Mode Switch

components.name: Selected Companion Card

components.name: Paper-Cut Story Stage
components.description: The cyan-sky and green-ground world with authored CSS scenery and navy ink edges.
components.css: .ds-stage { width:100%; height:360px; position:relative; isolation:isolate; overflow:hidden; border:3px solid #17324d; border-radius:28px; background:linear-gradient(#72d7f3 0%,#a9e8f4 67%,#91cc69 67%); box-shadow:0 18px 46px rgba(37,91,113,.18); } .ds-ground { position:absolute; z-index:-1; left:-2%; right:-2%; bottom:-7%; height:39%; border-radius:50% 50% 0 0/18% 18% 0 0; background:#91cc69; } .ds-cloud { position:absolute; width:100px; height:38px; border:5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82); border-radius:999px; } .ds-cloud.one { top:11%; left:12%; } .ds-cloud.two { top:22%; right:18%; transform:scale(.65); } .ds-sun,.ds-tree,.ds-apple { position:absolute; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-sun { top:14%; right:12%; width:74px; aspect-ratio:1; border:3px solid #17324d; border-radius:50%; background:#f8bd2d; box-shadow:0 0 0 10px #f36b3f,0 9px 0 rgba(23,50,77,.12); } .ds-sun i { position:absolute; inset:16%; border-radius:50%; background:#ffd969; } .ds-tree { left:16%; bottom:12%; width:106px; height:146px; } .ds-tree b { position:absolute; left:43%; bottom:0; width:20%; height:48%; border:3px solid #17324d; border-radius:5px; background:#9b5a3b; } .ds-tree i { position:absolute; z-index:2; left:17%; top:2%; width:66%; aspect-ratio:1; border:3px solid #17324d; border-radius:48% 52% 45% 55%; background:#58ab5d; box-shadow:-22px 24px 0 -5px #73bf63,22px 24px 0 -5px #65b653; } .ds-apple { right:29%; bottom:18%; width:46px; aspect-ratio:1; border:3px solid #17324d; border-radius:48% 52% 54% 46%; background:#ed4437; box-shadow:inset -8px -8px 0 rgba(157,31,28,.17),0 7px 0 rgba(23,50,77,.12); } .ds-stage button:hover { filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(23,50,77,.19)) brightness(1.04); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-stage button:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd34f; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
My Living Drawing is a warm, low-density paper-cut theater: cream paper surrounds a framed cyan sky and green ground, while thick navy ink holds every silhouette together. Coral is the single action voice. Rounded cards, taped-paper cues, physical shadow bases, and deliberately authored scenery make the experience feel handmade and immediately playable rather than like an AI dashboard.

The same identity must survive from character choice to motion. Product-provided companions use authored selection art and dedicated, identity-consistent 2×2 motion sprite sheets for idle, wave, jump, and eat states; the dog has its own matching motion sheet. Houses, sun, tree, apple, clouds, stars, and ground are authored in CSS as paper-cut scenery. Optional joint overlays sit on top of the motion artwork for inspection without replacing or permanently technicalizing it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper, cyan sky, green ground, coral actions, and navy outlines form one unmistakable world.
One framed stage is the interaction anchor; supporting controls stay compact and tactile.
AI-authored character identities remain recognizable across dedicated motion frames.
CSS scenery and paper-cut props replace decorative emoji in the living world.
All quick actions use one navy inline-SVG stroke family.
Motion is short, readable, object-specific, and fully reduced when requested.
Desktop layouts collapse deliberately at `820px`; compact mobile treatment begins at `560px`.

rules.name: The One Coral Voice Rule
rules.body: Coral signals action or deliberate emphasis; never scatter it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Navy Ink Rule
rules.body: Interactive shapes, authored props, and action icons share navy definition so they remain legible over cream, cyan, and green.

rules.name: The Friendly Weight Rule
rules.body: Use strong weight, compact line length, and scale for hierarchy; do not introduce thin editorial typography.

rules.name: The One Stage Rule
rules.body: Each step has one dominant framed task surface; secondary controls orbit it instead of creating competing dashboards.

rules.name: The Physical-Then-Ambient Rule
rules.body: Use hard offsets for touchable magnets and diffuse lift for frames, overlays, sprites, and scenery.

dos: Do keep cream paper, cyan sky, green ground, coral actions, and navy outlines consistent across every surface.
Do preserve each AI companion's identity across its dedicated motion frames.
Do author scene props as simple paper-cut CSS forms with navy edges and restrained shadows.
Do use the same navy inline-SVG stroke style for every quick action.
Do keep the joint overlay optional, labeled by anatomy, and visually secondary during motion.
Do preserve the `820px` and `560px` responsive behaviors, shared gold focus ring, and reduced-motion override.
Do keep Chinese copy concise, warm, honest about local Demo behavior, and immediately actionable.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a generic AI upload dashboard or dense control console.
Don't replace a selected character with a generic DOM puppet or unrelated animation asset.
Don't use emoji as the primary living-world art for sun, tree, apple, house, or dog when authored assets and CSS props exist.
Don't mix icon libraries, filled glyphs, or emoji into the unified quick-action SVG family.
Don't add gradients as ornamental UI styling, glass effects, or low-contrast decoration; the stage's day/night sky transition is functional scenery.
Don't show joint nodes permanently or force animal anatomy into human shoulder-and-hip terminology.
Don't imply live AI capability or saved personal data when the shipped experience is local and replaceable.
